limitations: No aggregate application delivery speed improvement if elapsed total increases; command/failure reductions are observed proxies, not proven fewer bugs or model turns.
Background concurrent VM work was observed; elapsed results include scheduling interference and uncontrolled agent/dispatch variation.
Main trials changed syntax, standard library, baseline structure, workflow and test workload together; no individual feature effect or causal attribution.
Autonomous maintenance is excluded from historical speed comparisons because its clock began at first check.
Matched maintenance retains begin-to-first-command gaps without correction; identical small program solutions do not establish general development advantage.
Exact model identity, model turns, tokens and cost are unknown. Gateway output bytes are captured output, not model context.
Separate followup test repairs do not alter timed submissions, acceptance or clocks.

review_findings.detail: zip silently truncates if the application returns fewer results than requested, including an empty results array. The new batch boundary tests could report success without checking every fixture.
review_findings.recommendation: Assert len(results) equals the batch size before iterating, or use zip with strict=True.
review_findings.title: Boundary tests do not assert result count

review_findings.detail: zip(graphs, results) truncates without checking that all requested graphs returned results. The later loop over result timings likewise does not verify one timing per job. The independent enumeration test could therefore pass on truncated results or missing timing entries. Other explicit fixtures provide some coverage, but this weakens the broadest independent check.
review_findings.recommendation: Assert result count equals graph count before zipping and assert timing IDs equal all expected sorted job IDs before checking each timing.
review_findings.title: Independent schedule checks can silently skip missing results

maintenance_method_finding: Same timing formula, different clock placement relative to dispatch. Historical begin precedes agent handoff; autonomous bridge begins with first check. Autonomous sequence not eligible for headline historical speed comparison.
next_experiments: Repeat matched tasks with multiple fresh contexts, identical declared verification workload and randomized order.
Separate syntax/library changes from workflow changes in controlled arms.
Implement and independently test required standard-library mechanisms before freezing baselines or starting application clocks.
Add a medium-size application with cross-module changes and meaningful error-handling requirements.

preparation.interpretation: 47.4 minutes elapsed preparation wall time, not summed CPU or development savings

review_followups.change: test assertions only: reject truncated result arrays; slack also requires complete sorted timing membership
